# plain Provider

Manage [Plain](https://www.plain.com) workspace configuration as code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    plain = {
      source = "jeremybumsted/plain"
    }
  }
}

provider "plain" {
  # Can also be supplied via the PLAIN_API_KEY environment variable.
  api_key = var.plain_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Plain API key. May also be set via the `PLAIN_API_KEY` environment variable. The key needs the permissions matching the resources you manage.
- `endpoint` (String) Plain GraphQL endpoint. May also be set via the `PLAIN_ENDPOINT` environment variable. Defaults to `https://core-api.uk.plain.com/graphql/v1`.
